prayerExcerpt.en-US: The Lord is truly risen, alleluia.

meta.face: Christ as in recurring-figures.md: a man of about thirty-three with a LONG OVAL face narrowing gently to the chin — a high, smooth forehead, a long straight nose with a fine bridge, calm almond-shaped dark-brown eyes under level brown brows, high, softly modelled cheekbones, a quiet closed mouth; chestnut-brown hair parted in the centre and falling in soft waves past the shoulders; a short, full chestnut beard and moustache, lightly parted at the chin; in glory, a plain gold halo ringed with rays, a serene, victorious look straight out at the viewer. The angel: youthful, an OVAL face with a straight nose, fair skin and loose light-golden hair, looking toward Christ. The soldiers' faces are hidden.
meta.basis: The Gospel accounts of the empty tomb (Mt 28:1-6, Jn 20:1) with the Western image of the risen Christ holding the banner of victory, as in Carl Bloch's Resurrection; Christ keeps the line from `transfiguration`.
